ic_name: LIN bus 2.2A (Local Interconnect Network, LIN Consortium)
test_cases_present: partial - the LIN spec defines protocol behaviour and a per-frame conformance signal (response_error) but does not bundle a full formal testbench. Categories below are derived from sections 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 2.7, 2.8 and chapters 3-5.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Header generation — Break (≥13 dominant bit times) + Break Delimiter (≥1 recessive) + Sync byte (0x55) + PID with correct P0/P1 parity, transmitted at the master's nominal bit time.
Break detection — slave detects 11-bit-time (or 9.5 for tight-tolerance slaves) dominant assertion as break, and aborts any in-progress slot.
Sync re-synchronisation — slave measures master's T_Bit from alternating 0x55 edges, then receives subsequent UART bytes within bit-rate tolerance.
PID parity sweep — for every ID in 0..63 verify computed (P0, P1) matches the table in section 2.8.2.
Unconditional frame (IDs 0..59) — publisher always responds with data + checksum within T_Frame_Maximum.

Event-triggered frame — publisher responds only if its associated unconditional frame has updated signal; if multiple publishers respond, master detects collision and switches to collision-resolving schedule table; resumes previous schedule after one pass.
Sporadic frame — slot empty if no signal updated; otherwise the highest-priority pending unconditional frame is transmitted.
Diagnostic frame (ID 0x3C / 0x3D) — always 8 data bytes, classic checksum, transport-layer PDU correctly assembled / disassembled (SF / FF + CF).
Reserved frame (ID 0x3E / 0x3F) — shall not be transmitted in a LIN 2.x cluster.
Classic checksum — sum over data bytes only; inverted result; verify against the example {0x4A, 0x55, 0x93, 0xE5} → 0xE6.
Enhanced checksum — sum over PID + data bytes; inverted result; mandatory for LIN 2.x non-diagnostic frames.
Schedule table — slot timing T_Frame_Slot > jitter + T_Frame_Maximum; switch requests honoured only at slot boundaries; schedule wraps at end.
Wake-up — dominant pulse 250 µs to 5 ms wakes all slaves within 100 ms; ≥150 µs detection threshold.
Wake retry — silence between attempts 150-250 ms; ≥1.5 s silence after 3 failed attempts.
Go-To-Sleep command — master-request frame ID 0x3C with data1=0, data2..data8=0xFF puts cluster into bus sleep mode.
Implicit sleep — slave auto-enters bus sleep mode after 4-10 s of bus inactivity.
response_error signal — set on framing/bit/checksum/PID-parity/no-response error on a non-event-triggered slot; cleared once carrying unconditional frame transmitted.
Error_in_response / Successful_transfer flags (within own node).
Bit error detection on transmitter — UART readback mismatch aborted no later than end of mismatching byte field.
Initialising → Operational transition completes within 100 ms.
LIN 1.3 / LIN 2.x interoperability — master refrains from enhanced-checksum, reconfig/diag, automatic baud-rate detection, response_error monitoring on LIN 1.3 slaves.
Node configuration services — Assign NAD, Conditional Change NAD, Data Dump, Save Configuration, Assign frame ID range.
Read by Identifier service — returns Supplier ID, Function ID, Variant + ECU-specific identifiers.
Transport-layer Single Frame (SF) — LEN 1..6 service data with NAD + PCI + SID.
Transport-layer Multi-Frame — FF (PCI = 0x1L) + sequence of CF (PCI = 0x2S, S = 1..15 cycling); total LEN up to 4095 bytes.
